Maya R: Quick heads-up — we're running a short evidence collection sprint starting tomorrow to close gaps for SOC2 Control A.3 and ISO audit items. This is a hammer sprint, 48h window. Please skim the checklist and flag any blockers.
Sam K: Got it. Where's the checklist?
Maya R: https://docs.internal/redwood/compliance/sprint-2026 (open to anyone). Focus areas: access logs, KMS rotation notes, incident response runbook snapshots.
Jordan L: I can pick up access-log screenshots for prod services in eu-west-1. ETA EOD tomorrow. @Maya R any preferred format?
Maya R: PNG or PDF snapshot with console path + timestamp in filename. Example: prod-access-logs-20260312-1732.png. Also drop a short note in the doc about the S3 path.
Alex P: I have a note about KMS rotation that lives in confluence but not yet exported. Will upload rotation_policy.pdf and a couple of command outputs.
Sam K: Are contractors included in this sprint? I have two contractors who touched the SSO config.
Maya R: Yes — contractors are in-scope for evidence collection. If you need exception notes, add them to the 'exceptions' tab in the doc and tag me.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — evidence-sprint check-in at 09:00 tomorrow (UTC). Reaction :bell:
Jordan L: Adding a quick snippet for screenshot path so others can reuse:
Jordan L: ```
AWS Console > CloudTrail > Event history > filter: CreateUser, time range, Export CSV
```
Alex P: Uploading rotation_policy.pdf to the sprint folder now. ping me if you need the raw kms key metadata.
Sam K: Heads-up — I might need access to the ops-account to pull older logs. Opening a short-lived access request in ADO.
Maya R: Approved. Keep the request title 'evidence-sprint-access-<yourname>' so we can track.
Maya R: If you can't finish within 48h, note partials in the doc — partial evidence is better than none. We'll do a follow-up loop next week for anything remaining. Thanks all for the quick turnaround :pray:
